tooling.message:
test: the planted app's Playwright config launches the installed Chromium of lernapps check

## Intent

Where Playwright's own Chromium is missing, lernapps check starts an installed one and passes it in LERNAPPS_CHROMIUM. The plain Playwright config of the check-repo test ignored it and failed in a sandbox, which blocked the pre-push run.

## Key changes

- The test's config launches the browser from LERNAPPS_CHROMIUM when it is set.
